purpose: Record the bounded deterministic independent-review producer and GitHub App witness-publication invariants for this candidate without claiming bootstrap authority, founder-final approval, merge authority, deployment authority, live provider enforcement, or runtime trigger activation.

claims: src/review/deterministicReviewProducer.ts must derive the exact repository, pull request, base/head identity, author, complete diff hash, server-owned policy hash, deterministic findings, verdict, and proposal-only receipt from provider-observed state; trust-root self-modification and unavailable rename provenance must fail closed instead of certifying the candidate.

src/review/deterministicReviewWitnessPublisher.ts may publish only a clear deterministic receipt through the repository provider's narrow witness capability, must bind pre/post publication PR identity and exact head, and must reject success unless provider readback reports the exact derived signal from the server-owned numeric GITHUB_APP_ID.

src/providers/DeterministicReviewGitHubProvider.ts must restrict deterministic witness publication to the canonical Founder Control Room repository and exact success-only Check Run shape, and must reject malformed or substituted head SHA, review hash, derived signal name, or bounded summary before any provider mutation.

src/providers/RepositoryProvider.ts exposes only a narrow optional deterministic-review witness publication capability rather than ambient generic Check Run authority, and consumers must fail closed when that capability is unavailable.

src/providers/providerFactory.ts must expose deterministic review witness publication for Founder Control Room only when GITHUB_APP_ID plus GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY mint the repository-scoped GitHub App installation token; a local or development GITHUB_TOKEN fallback cannot mint deterministic review evidence.
